note: Second feeds off GitHub that are in service, and the runner verdict that put them there. Nothing in this repository can reach Wikipedia or football-data.co.uk: the development sandbox allows GitHub and denies everything else, so a feed is armed on evidence produced by an Actions runner and this file is where that evidence is copied. Each row is a line from the probe step of the run it names, and can be read back against it.

probes.note: One score in 238 disagrees, which the 95% floor exists to absorb: feeds differ over awarded results, and a forfeit recorded 3-0 by one and 0-0 by the other is not a different competition. Poltava is minted deliberately as its own club and not as a second name for Vorskla Poltava; see wikifootball.DISTINCT for what settled that and how strong the evidence is.

probes.used_for: the season's entrant list only; the results in service come from football-data.co.uk, which carries dates
